monitor.scope: Five-second wait plus query duration, timestamped after each nvidia-smi query. Samples cover recorded GPU compute processes only; they do not exclude short activity between samples or establish CPU isolation/clock/utilization stability.

interpretation: Only P0/current share the audited placement/execution/timing contracts. Published is descriptive historical context.
Intermediate is the accepted pre-layout-cache diagnostic; no claim that it is final. Its missing continuous process monitor remains a recorded limitation.
Per-run phase means are aggregated by the median of three independent runs. Positive deltas within P0 range remain marked as increases; no arbitrary percentage acceptance threshold is applied.
Saved phase medians need not sum because different phases can select different median runs. No source or GPU mutation was performed.
